summary: Evidence packet for the runx bookkeeper skill (automerchlab/bookkeeper@1.0.2). The skill reads a transaction statement from a REAL source at runtime (a live HTTPS web-fetch of the U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data DTS operating-cash statement for 2026-07-16), categorizes every transaction to an existing account in chart_of_accounts with a confidence and a reason and never invents a GL account, flags anomalies, and emits a read-only reconciliation{matched, unmatched} which it seals as an append_event audit record (bookkeeping_reconciliation aggregate) - real source read AND a consumed governed effect in one run. A post-publish dogfood of the PUBLISHED graph package (registry_source=remote, version=1.0.2) read 180 live statement lines, categorized 173 to GL accounts and left 7 as flagged anomalies (never booked to an invented account), reconciled matched count=173 amount=569963 against unmatched count=7, and sealed event 8f9ccb1edfef121df79aa70ac9a3ed25a8d3729564f9e7bbca1b529c4238f464; the sealed runx.receipt.v1 passes runx verify with a production signature. source_url, X.yaml, SKILL.md and verification.json resolve at a single source revision (commit a8b7a396d13251261589fb510f8e279ae29b3342); this evidence packet and report are its direct child. The committed skill files are the files published as automerchlab/bookkeeper@1.0.2, and the dogfood ran that published package from the remote registry, not a local path. It books nothing to a live ledger (ledger_mutation_performed=false).

dogfood.command: runx skill automerchlab/bookkeeper@1.0.2 bookkeep --registry https://api.runx.ai -j -i "statement_url=https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v1/accounting/dts/deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash?fields=record_date,account_type,transaction_type,transaction_catg,transaction_today_amt&sort=transaction_catg&page[size]=500" -i statement_date=2026-07-16 --input-json prior_period='{"opening_balance": 800000, "prior_net": 12000}' -R ./receipts
